insight: Founded 2023 by Soham Ganatra and Karan Vaidya; raised a $25M round led by Lightspeed in 2025.
name: Composio
tagline: Authenticated toolkits that give AI agents access to SaaS apps, via MCP or API.
description: Tool layer that gives AI agents secure, managed access to 1000+ toolkits and 20,000+ tools across SaaS apps, exposed via MCP or direct APIs. It handles authentication, tool search, and context management, and its MCP Gateway hands each team a managed endpoint to paste into Claude, Cursor, or ChatGPT. The core is MIT-licensed; a free tier covers 20K tool calls per month.
edge: Handles per-integration OAuth so agents get authenticated, production-ready tools instead of raw API stubs to wire up.
